nodes.description: Address authorized to execute queued proposals and to call the guardian-only admin functions
Two-step guardian transfer target that becomes guardian after acceptGuardianship
Timelock delay in seconds used for the queue eta, defaults to MINIMUM_DELAY
mapping(bytes32 => bool) of queued/executed timelock transaction hashes
mapping(uint => Proposal) storing proposals, votes, receipt state and execution flags
mapping(address => uint) latest proposal per proposer, used for one-live-proposal rule
immutable IKeep3rV1 governance token interface used for prior votes and totalBonded
Total number of proposals ever created, incremented in _propose
Quorum percentage (in BASE units) of total bonded tokens required for a proposal to pass
Proposal threshold percentage (in BASE units) of total bonded tokens required to propose
msg.sender compared to address(this) in setQuorum, setThreshold and setDelay (timelock only)
msg.sender used by the onlyGuardian modifier and the execute guardian check
Miner-controlled timestamp used for queue eta, staleness and expiry checks
msg.sender used as proposer/voter identity for KPR.getPriorVotes lookups
Low-level call target.call{value:value}(callData) that executes arbitrary proposal actions
ecrecover based EIP-712 signature check in castVoteBySig
setQuorum(uint): timelock-only setter requiring msg.sender == address(this)
setThreshold(uint): timelock-only setter requiring msg.sender == address(this)
setDelay(uint): timelock-only setter of the timelock delay
propose(...): public proposal entry point gated by proposer prior votes and one-live-proposal rule
_propose(...): internal proposal creation, increments proposalCount and writes proposal records
queue(uint): queues a succeeded proposal into the timelock using block.timestamp + delay
_queueOrRevert(...): guards against duplicate queued actions then queues them
execute(uint): payable guardian-gated execution of a queued proposal
_executeTransaction(...): validates timelock timing and performs the low-level external call
cancel(uint): cancels a proposal if the proposer fell below the threshold
state(uint): derives ProposalState from block.number, votes and block.timestamp
castVote(uint,bool): votes with msg.sender as the voter
castVoteBySig(uint,bool,uint8,bytes32,bytes32): votes on behalf of an EIP-712 signer
_castVote(address,uint,bool): records a vote and adds prior votes to for/against tallies
acceptGuardianship(): pending guardian becomes the guardian
addVotes(address,uint): guardian-only privileged call forwarding to KPR.addVotes (representative of the guardian-only admin batch)
_queueTransaction(...): validates eta against block.timestamp + delay and stores txHash
setGuardian(address): guardian-only two-step guardian nomination
quorumVotes(): quorum computed from KPR.totalBonded() scaled by _quorumVotes
proposalThreshold(): threshold computed from KPR.totalBonded() scaled by _proposalThreshold
quorum_ argument of setQuorum, written into _quorumVotes
threshold_ argument of setThreshold, written into _proposalThreshold
delay_ argument of setDelay, written into delay
proposalId argument of queue, indexes the proposals mapping
proposalId argument of execute, indexes the proposals mapping
proposalId argument of state, indexes the proposals mapping
proposalId argument hashed into the EIP-712 ballot of castVoteBySig
support argument hashed into the EIP-712 ballot of castVoteBySig
v, r, s ECDSA signature components passed to ecrecover in castVoteBySig
targets, values, signatures, calldatas and description array arguments of propose
target, value, signature, data and eta arguments of _executeTransaction/_queueTransaction
_guardian argument of setGuardian, stored into pendingGuardian
voter and amount arguments of the guardian-only addVotes admin call
startBlock and endBlock locals computed from block.number plus votingDelay/votingPeriod
newProposal memory struct assembled and stored into proposals
eta local computed as block.timestamp + delay in queue
storage pointer to the proposal being executed in execute
votes local obtained from KPR.getPriorVotes and added to the tallies
callData local built from signature and data and forwarded to the low-level call
success and returnData locals returned by the low-level call
txHash local computed from the action parameters and stored in queuedTransactions
signatory local recovered by ecrecover and passed to _castVote
latestProposalId local read from latestProposalIds to enforce one live proposal per proposer

threshold_ parameter is validated against BASE and written into _proposalThreshold
delay_ parameter is bounded by MINIMUM_DELAY/MAXIMUM_DELAY and written into delay
proposalId selects which proposal is queued
proposalId selects which proposal is executed
proposalId selects which proposal state is computed
proposalId is hashed into the ballot struct digest
support flag is hashed into the ballot struct digest
v, r, s signature components are consumed by ecrecover
proposal action arrays flow from the propose arguments into the checks and _propose
target, value, signature, data and eta flow into the timelock execution checks and call
_guardian argument is written into pendingGuardian
voter and amount arguments are forwarded to KPR.addVotes
latestProposalId local is compared against the stored latestProposalIds[msg.sender]
recovered signatory address is used as the voter in _castVote
computed txHash is set to true in queuedTransactions
callData built from the proposal signature/data is supplied to the low-level call
success and returnData are produced by the low-level call as output
votes local is added to proposal.forVotes or proposal.againstVotes
the storage proposal pointer is mutated (executed flag) during execution
newProposal struct is written into proposals[newProposal.id]
eta computed in queue is stored on the proposal
startBlock and endBlock locals are computed inside _propose
newProposal struct is constructed inside _propose
eta local is computed as block.timestamp.add(delay) inside queue
storage pointer to the executed proposal is taken inside execute
votes local is fetched from KPR.getPriorVotes inside _castVote
callData local is assembled inside _executeTransaction
success/returnData locals are captured from the low-level call inside _executeTransaction
txHash local is derived from the action tuple inside _queueTransaction
signatory local is produced by ecrecover inside castVoteBySig
latestProposalId local is read from latestProposalIds[msg.sender] inside propose
setQuorum requires msg.sender == address(this) (timelock/governance self-call)
setThreshold requires msg.sender == address(this) (timelock/governance self-call)
setDelay requires msg.sender == address(this) (timelock/governance self-call)
setGuardian is protected by the onlyGuardian modifier (msg.sender == guardian)
execute requires msg.sender == guardian once a guardian is set
acceptGuardianship requires msg.sender == pendingGuardian
all guardian-only admin functions are restricted to msg.sender == guardian
queue derives eta from the miner-influenced block.timestamp (timestamp dependency)
state() uses block.timestamp for GRACE_PERIOD expiry (timestamp dependency)
_executeTransaction uses block.timestamp for eta and staleness bounds (timestamp dependency)
_queueTransaction requires eta >= block.timestamp + delay (timestamp dependency)
msg.sender is used as proposer identity and for the prior-votes lookup in propose
msg.sender is passed as the voter to _castVote from castVote
KPR.getPriorVotes(msg.sender, ...) is used to gate proposal creation
KPR.getPriorVotes(voter, proposal.startBlock) determines the vote weight
KPR.totalBonded() is the base for the quorum computation
KPR.totalBonded() is the base for the proposal threshold computation
pendingGuardian is promoted into guardian by acceptGuardianship
setGuardian stores the nominated address into pendingGuardian
proposalCount++ is an unchecked increment on a counter that also drives proposal ids
_propose writes the new proposal struct into the proposals mapping
_propose records the new proposal id as the proposer's latest proposal
queue reads the timelock delay to compute the execution eta
_queueTransaction marks the transaction hash as queued
_executeTransaction clears the queued flag before performing the external call
execute marks the proposal as executed and reads its actions
cancel sets the canceled flag and reads the proposal actions
state reads the proposal record to derive the current state
queue reads the stored proposal targets, values, signatures and calldatas
execute reads the stored proposal actions and eta
cancel reads the stored proposal actions and proposer
propose delegates proposal creation to _propose
propose compares proposer votes against proposalThreshold()
propose calls state() to check the proposer's latest proposal state
queue iterates the proposal actions and calls _queueOrRevert for each
queue requires state(proposalId) == Succeeded
_queueOrRevert forwards the action to _queueTransaction
execute iterates the proposal actions and calls _executeTransaction for each
execute requires state(proposalId) == Queued
cancel reads the proposal state before cancelling
castVote forwards to _castVote with msg.sender as voter
castVoteBySig recovers the signer with ecrecover
castVoteBySig forwards the recovered signatory to _castVote
_castVote requires state(proposalId) == Active
state() calls quorumVotes() to decide Defeated/Succeeded
quorumVotes scales totalBonded by the _quorumVotes percentage
proposalThreshold scales totalBonded by the _proposalThreshold percentage
_executeTransaction performs the arbitrary low-level external call after clearing the queued flag
The arbitrary external target can re-enter execute() while state mutations and further calls are still in progress
Re-entering _executeTransaction allows replay of actions whose queued flag was cleared before the call

normalization_plan.reason: quorum_ is only meaningful as the input of setQuorum and can be merged into that core function node
threshold_ is only meaningful as the input of setThreshold
delay_ is only meaningful as the input of setDelay
proposalId is consumed only by queue and can be merged into it
proposalId is consumed only by execute and can be merged into it
proposalId is consumed only by state and can be merged into it
proposalId feeds only the ballot digest of castVoteBySig
support feeds only the ballot digest of castVoteBySig
v, r, s feed only the ecrecover step of castVoteBySig
the proposal action arrays are the external input surface of propose
target/value/signature/data/eta define the low-level call performed by _executeTransaction
_guardian is the sole input of the guardian nomination function
voter and amount are forwarded straight into the privileged KPR.addVotes call
block window locals exist only during _propose and do not need separate identity
the newProposal struct is a temporary of _propose
eta is a temporary timelock deadline computed inside queue
the storage pointer local is an internal detail of execute
votes is a temporary tally value inside _castVote
callData is built solely for the low-level call performed by _executeTransaction
success/returnData are outputs of the low-level call made by _executeTransaction
txHash is the internal key computed while queueing a timelock transaction
signatory is a temporary recovered address used only inside castVoteBySig
latestProposalId is a temporary lookup value used to enforce the one-live-proposal rule in propose
